text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since full-scale training began with Still in Love.
As for her usual running form—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Your form really is gorgeous.
Your form really is gorgeous, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you really think so?
...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I worked particularly hard on that, so...
I'm really glad."
choice_data_list: Focusing on that specifically?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. When things get serious, that girl...
will surely show you an unseemly race."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that I at least wanted
my form to be proper and beautiful...
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aside from her form, her usual running is flawless overall. She must have worked diligently and steadily toward this.
choice_data_list: (Still—... "it falls short".)

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
—Umamusume participating in the mock race
on Course A, please assemble!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: It's time.
It's time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that I had a general grasp of her abilities,
I signed her up for a mock race today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since many Umamusume who have already debuted will participate,
the goal is to gauge our current challenges by comparison.
However... that also means the competition will be "strong."
choice_data_list: ...Take care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a bad premonition and sounded the alarm, but...
—it woke up anyway.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufufufufu...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, all of them look so delicious...!
Yes... yes... indeed... I've decided.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—I'll make every last one of you...
my flesh and blooddd!! Ahahahaaaa!!!!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
choice_data_list: (This is it... this speed...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tremble at the bizarre sight, yet my heart races—
Driven by raw instinct, her blistering speed is undeniably
equal to any legendary Umamusume of the past...!
choice_data_list: (If I could head straight into the race like this—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
C-Crap... what was that just now...——
It's terrifying...——

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what just happened?
Was there someone like that here before...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I-I've done it... again...
Ah, how utterly unseemly of me...!
choice_data_list: Calm down. ...Shall we get moving?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —I am truly, thoroughly ashamed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She feels ashamed and repulsed by her own
fiercely competitive side—her instinctual nature.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Did I... make everyone
uncomfortable again...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Do they hate me now, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Ever since her instincts began surfacing, she stood out from those around her. I heard she came to hate drawing attention to herself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before signing our contract, calling her true, instinctive self "beautiful" came straight from the heart. She didn't reject me back then, but—
choice_data_list: (It's not something that's easily accepted, after all.)
(It's not something that's easily accepted, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help change her mood, I search for another topic.
What comes to mind is something I felt we needed to talk about eventually—her "dream."
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, I haven't heard about your dream yet.
Come to think of it, I haven't heard about your dream yet.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: A dream...?
choice_data_list: Like a record to aim for, or a target race.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...My dream is...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: ...Is there something on my face?
...Is there something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You're right... A dream...
Up until now, I didn't even know if I'd ever be able to debut...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... I do yearn for... the Triple Tiara route.
choice_data_list: So it's the Tiara route...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are various paths one can take in the Twinkle Series.
Among them, one of the primary routes celebrated
for its sheer glamour is the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara, consisting of the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho, is a brilliance that can only be seized during the Classic Year... Every year, it draws the yearning of many.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I can only obtain that dazzling brilliance...
I am certain everyone will acknowledge me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To be loved.
I think that's... wonderful.
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...T-Trainer-san,
what do you think? About the Tiara route..."
choice_data_list: Of course, I think it's wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time Still in Love has shared
her own dream with me... I want to give her my full support
and boost her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As I was pondering various things
about the Tiara route..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah...!
It's Lady Ramonu...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (Mejiro Ramonu...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu. The legendary Umamusume who achieved the first Triple Tiara in history.
And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—To this day, no other Umamusume besides her
has ever achieved the Triple Tiara."
choice_data_list: ...I saw Ramonu's greatness with my own eyes.
...I saw Ramonu's great achievement with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —I want to love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu ran with beauty and strength
right until the very last moment. One could say her presence
defined the very essence of the Triple Tiara route thereafter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her run with all her heart, with such love
for racing... How many times has she captivated me?
choice_data_list: That brilliance—I'll never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: So you surely will too—
That's why I'm sure you will too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running the Tiara route, she would be bathed in a radiant brilliance... supported and loved by many.
I was about to continue, but—"
choice_data_list: ...Still?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I am terribly sorry, 
but today... I must take my leave here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Aah... Why did I...?
But...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...I couldn't take it. Hearing Trainer speak with such intense passion...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (To say... that you couldn't forget that radiance...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please don't look at anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (No, Still...! How unladylike...)

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, things are becoming clearer now, aren't they?
What I need to do...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What we should do...
Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
What I need to do to steal her heart.
—I just have to win the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara...
If I do that, then Trainer...—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...! T-That's... impossible.
No one has achieved that since Ramonu-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Besides... to "steal" something? Oh, what a terrifying thing to say...!

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
—Otherwise, his heart will remain
trapped by that demonic allure forever.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? Don't you want it?
His... His heart."

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: A soul so melt-in-the-mouth... delightfully sweet.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: —Take it by force.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
The peerless glory of the Triple Tiara...
And that person's heart, all of it.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: "S n a t c h   i t   a w a y"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer.
choice_data_list: Still...! I was looking everywhere for you--

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
About that dream...
...May I continue where we left off?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—I want to become the second Triple Tiara Umamusume in history...
since Ramonu-san.”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It may be an unfitting dream for me.
Even so... I want it more than anything.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Would that be funny, do you think?
choice_data_list: ...Not at all. Isn't it the greatest dream?
...No way. It's the greatest dream, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why did such a reserved girl suddenly
aim for such a monumental feat...? I didn't know.
Still, as her Trainer, I only had one thing to say.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for it. I know you can make it come true.
Let us aim for it. I am certain you can achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: (That's right, if it's you... you can do it.)
(That's right, if it's you... you can do it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is by no means a pipedream.
—If we can draw out
every bit of power she possesses.
